discovery.name: Didymos
discovery.discovery: Discovered 1996 Apr. 11 by Spacewatch at Kitt Peak.
discovery.citation: Greek for “twin”, this rapid-rotator Amor possesses a satellite with an orbital period of 11.9 hr.  Suspicions arose in the Goldstone delay-Doppler echoes, and these were confirmed with the optical light curve analysis, along with Arecibo radar imaging on 2003 Nov. 23.  The name was suggested by J. Montani.
